sections.skill: Close or pause a business responsibly

questions.prompt: What should happen to prepaid orders when closing?

choices.text: Ship empty boxes to close the orders
Keep the money and say nothing to anyone
Ask customers to forget the orders
Fulfill them or refund the customers

questions.correct_answer: Fulfill them or refund the customers
questions.intro: Sometimes the right decision is to CLOSE or pause a business. Winding down honestly means: finish or refund customer orders and prepaid services; tell customers and suppliers clearly; pay what you owe as far as possible; cancel subscriptions and licenses; file final tax returns and any state DISSOLUTION papers for an LLC or corporation; and keep records for the required period. Closing well protects your reputation and your future options.

sections.skill: Moving out of an apartment the right way

questions.prompt: Giving notice is like what in a business?
questions.correct_answer: Telling customers and suppliers
questions.intro: When you move out, you give notice, pay the last rent, return the keys, clean up, and forward your mail. If you just disappear, the landlord is stuck, you may lose your deposit, and it is harder to rent next time. Closing a business is similar: notice, payments, paperwork and records, so you leave on good terms.
